Profile Cajuput oil is a volatile oil obtained by distillation from the fresh leaves and twigs of Melaleuca cajuputi (M. leucadendron) (Myrtaceae). It contains cineole. Cajuput oil has been applied externally as a stimulant and mild rubefacient in rheumatism. It is also used with other volatile agents in preparations for the relief of respiratory-tract disorders and nasal congestion. It is also used in aromatherapy.
